Commentary.Commentary: Right then! Pakistan earn their first bilateral series win in ODIs in 15 months, after beating Zimbabwe in July 2018. What do the T20Is hold in store? Some exciting names are cropping up. That format of the tour will be played in Lahore. Join us on Saturday, 5th October, 2019 at 6.30 pm local (1330 GMT). ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious Pakistan captain, Sarfaraz Ahmed, thanks the almighty as well. Praises Abid Ali for handling the pressure and then credits every batsman for chipping in. Admits that Pakistan's fielding was not up to the mark and believes that if his team continues to field like this, they will not win against bigger teams. Thanks the crowd for coming in large numbers to support the home team. On the upcoming T20I series, Sarfaraz stresses that Sri Lanka are a very strong team in this format and his unit won't take them lightly.

Sri Lankan skipper, Lahiru Thirimanne, feels proud of his team for fighting hard. Feels that scoring 297 was great but the bowling did not execute its plans in the first 10-15 overs. In the series overall, Thirimanne agrees that the youngsters are making the world take notice of the Lankans, with Shanaka, Jayasuriya and Gunathilaka making out some noises. On his experience of playing in Pakistan, Lahiru feels it was exciting and encourages other teams to come here and play.

PAKISTAN'S BABAR AZAM HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE SERIES. He too, thanks the almighty for his performance. Feels proud of scoring his first international century in Pakistan. On his score in the previous innings, Azam says that he wanted to take the innings deep and then accelerate. Hopes to take this momentum and form into the T20I series as well.

PAKISTAN'S ABID ALI HAS BEEN NAMED THE MAN OF THE MATCH. Thanks the almighty and feels how much ever he thanks the one above, it will always be less. Thanks the team and support staff for backing him. On the feeling of playing international cricket in Pakistan, Abid thanks the fans and hopes that more international cricket will come to Pakistan.
The match referee and the umpires are given their medallions.

Earlier in the day, a fine century from Danushka Gunathilaka and a cameo from Dasun Shanaka carried Sri Lanka close to 300. Pakistan struggled with the ball in the early parts but will believe that they came back nicely towards the latter stages. Please stay tuned for the presentation...

Sri Lankan bowling, well, they tried hard but were inconsistent. Pradeep and Shanaka started well, only to have their efforts spoilt by Lahiru Kumara. Then, when the spinners brought them back into the game, the new-ball bowlers erred at the death. A tough learning curve but this is one game where they will believe, was lost from the bag. Take for instance, that 46th over, which went for 18. Pakistan needed 37 in 30 before that over.

A rare failure it was for Babar Azam but the others chipped in nicely. Abid Ali made full use of Imam-ul-Haq's absence while Fakhar Zaman got some much-needed runs with consecutive fifties. Sarfraz came in at number 4 but remained invisible while Haris Sohail once again strutted his importance to the team. And then, that factor which was missing for many months in the Pakistan unit - the death batting factor. Iftikhar Ahmed comes in as a breath of fresh air and he has shown that he has the acceleration punch in him to play quickfire knocks.

Fakhar Zaman and a new opener, Abid Ali, laid the platform with a solid 123-run stand but even after that was broken, there was never a 'familiar' Pakistan collapse. There was of course a period in between when the hosts slipped, losing 2 quick wickets for 8 runs in 15 balls but the middle order handled things efficiently.

A rare scenario where Pakistan's batting has won them a game. It is a very good scorecard if your openers get a century stand and each scores a half century. And it reads even better if there are three 50-plus stands in the first four partnerships.

'Sri Lanka lose but are not disgraced,' says Roshan Abeysinghe on air. Ummm... not quite sure in terms of agreement to that statement. The Lankans were in with a decent chance to win but some poor fielding and indifferent bowling saw them lose their grip.

FOUR! More freebies from Pradeep. Another full toss, down the leg side again, this time a lower one, Iftikhar just tickles it towards the fine leg fence once more! PAKISTAN WIN BY 5 WICKETS AND 10 BALLS TO SPARE, TAKE THE SERIES 2-0!
SIX! Oh dear. A poor, poor, poor ball. A high full toss, down the leg side, Iftikhar pulls it over fine leg and the ball clears the ropes!
Outside off, dabbed to short third man for a quick single.

Full and outside off, Riaz announces his intentions straightaway, getting down and slogging it towards deep mid-wicket. Lakshan Sandakan over there does not charge in but plays it safe, staying back and taking it on the bounce. A single taken.
Wahab Riaz walks in at number 7, replacing Sohail. Ahead of Nawaz and Shadab.

OUT! BOWLED! That has gone right through. How did he miss that? 'Am I out?' asks Haris to Iftikhar. Even he is dumbfounded. A nothing delivery, full and straight. Haris backed away and looked to force it through the off side but perhaps it was a quicker delivery. He missed it and the ball hit the middle stump. Too late for some drama? End of a wonderful innings from Haris Sohail. 11 more needed from 14 balls.
Around of, worked through mid-wicket for a run.

Comes down the track again, this time gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it towards long off for one.

Outside off, punched straight to cover.

Short on top of off, Sohail strokes it to long on and keeps the strike. 6 off the over. 47 needed off the last 7 now.
Short and wide outside off. Haris cuts it hard but straight to the man at point.
Gives this air on off, Haris lofts his drive over extra cover and gets a couple. 250 comes up with that for Pakistan.
Poor ball. Too full and down the leg side. Iftikhar sweeps it towards deep backward square leg and gets just a single.

Pulled hard but there is a man in the deep. Good length ball outside off, Iftikhar pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.

Good length ball on off, Iftikar defends it towards cover.

He gets a thick inside edge onto the stumps. Game on!
On off, Haris nudges it wide of sweeper cover and gets a couple. 54 needed off 54 now.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Flighted on off, Haris milks it towards long off for an easy single.
Floats one on off and middle, Sarfaraz nudges it towards long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Sarfaraz strokes it towards long on for a single. 50-run stand comes up between the two.
Floated outside off and it comes in. Sarfaraz looks to drive but gets a faint inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes behind allowing them to take a single.
Shehan Jayasuriya to inaugurate the final Powerplay. 3-0-17-0 so far.
Powerplay 3 signalled by the umpire. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the game.
Yorker on the stumps. Haris does well to dig it out.
Good length ball on off, Ahmed runs it down to third man for a single.

On the pads, Haris flicks it to square leg.
Good length ball around off, Sarfaraz pulls it towards deep mid-wicket.

On the pads, Haris flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.

Floated outside off, Sarfaraz punches it towards cover and gets to the other end.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Good length ball around off, Haris picks the length early and punches it through extra cover for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Haris slams it through point. The man at sweeper cover does a really good job as he cleans it up with a good dive. Saves 2 for his side.
Very good shot but just a single. Full on middle, Sarfaraz drives it towards mid on for a single.
On middle and leg, Sarfaraz flicks it to mid-wicket.
Full on off, Sohail strokes it towards cover for a single.
On the pads, Sarfaraz looks to flick but misses. The ball goes towards backward point off his pads. They take a leg bye.
On the pads, Sarfaraz flicks it to square leg.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Very poor from the fielder there. Low full toss on middle and off, Haris flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs to his right but takes it too easily and he ends up misreading it and the ball goes through him to the fence.

Good length ball on off, SA runs it down to third man for a run.

Aggression there. Full on off, Sarfaraz taps it back to the bowler and comes forward just a bit.  Nuwan gathers the ball and has a shy at the keeper's end but it misses and luckily it goes to the left of the keeper and not far away.
Tossed up on off, Haris punches it wide of long on for a couple. 104 needed off 102.

DRINKS BREAK. Now then! We are talking. 109 needed in 111 balls. 7 wickets in hand but relatively new batsmen at the crease and not much experience to follow. Do Sri Lanka have a sniff? It was going smoothly for Pakistan but out of nowhere, Nuwan Pradeep has given his side a good chance. In the span of 9 balls, he has dismissed both set batsmen, Babar and Fakhar and is running in with hot steam. How will Pakistan respond now? Here comes HARIS SOHAIL.

OUT! Caught! Straight to the man! Oh boy, Zaman has thrown it away. He has auditioned himself for the role of Sri Lanka's fielding coach in the best possible manner. Short and outside off, Fakhar backs away and looks to play the upper cut. He does connect well but finds Dasun Shanaka at short third man! Zaman stands there in disgust, looking at the ground. Could not have picked out the fielder any better. One wicket brings another in quick succession. Is the game turning?
Around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
A length ball, outside off, angled in, Zaman looks to tuck it through the leg side but misses and is hit on the pads. Again, he does not know where the ball is, running wildly before scampering back.
Full and down the leg side, swept fine for a single.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Landed outside off, Sarfaraz looks to push but misses. The keeper fumbles and concedes a bye.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Full and around off, swept through mid-wicket for a couple.
WIDE. The googly, outside off, spinning away, well past the guidelines, left alone.

EDGED, DROPPED! Tough chance. But should have been taken at this level. The chinaman, outside off, spinning away, Zaman looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies behind but Danushka Gunathilaka at first slip is late to react. The ball hits his right palm and deflects towards short fine leg. A single taken.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single. 2 runs and the most important wicket in the over.
Around off, defended from the crease.

Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
A beauty to welcome the skipper. On a length outside off, Sarfaraz plays inside the line and is beaten as the ball straightens a touch.
Interesting. Sarfaraz Ahmed walks in at number 4, replacing Babar Azam.

OUT! LBW! Another decision overturned. Big, big moment in the game. It is not done yet, folks. 117 more needed, 8 wickets in hand but Pakistan's Bradman is gone. Superb review from Thirimanne. A length ball, around off, cutting back in sharply, Azam looked to defend but missed and was hit on the pads. Pradeep screamed his lungs out on the appeal but umpire Wilson was dead as a stone in his expressions. Thirimanne asked his keeper and then went for the review. Golden call as Ball Tracker returns three reds! A rare 'failure' for Azam. His lowest score in his last 7 ODI innings!
'Howzzat?' roars Pradeep. Umpire Joel Wilson neither says yes, nor no. Thirimanne signals for the review. Ball Tracker says three reds! Babar is gone!
Nuwan Pradeep is back on. 4-1-26-0 so far.
Outside off, spinning in, Zaman punches it to the leg side.

Outside off, a length ball, Zaman slashes but misses.

Babar screams his lungs out and now FZ realizes where the ball is and also sees Kumara charging in, to kick the ball onto the stumps.  Gets back in time.

The fielder comes quickly too, to his right but then fires a wild throw. The ball is well wide of the keeper, to his left and the man at slip backing up, is going to his right in anticipation. Cannot rewind his steps. Short third man dives to his right but of no use. Sandakan has his hands on his head.

Full and down the leg side, helped through fine leg for one.

TOP EDGE, but safe. Consecutive half centuries for Zaman. Full and wide outside off, Fakhar backs away and looks to go inside out. Gets a top edge which clears point. A single taken. Needs to understand that this is not the time to counter-attack. Take some time and then play your shots.

A dipping full toss just below the waist height from Hasaranga. Abid Ali swings his bat at it but mistimes his pull. It goes to the left of Samarawickrama at deep mid-wicket. He gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it as he dives on that side. How costly will it prove to be?
Slower through the air on off, Fakhar looks to defend but the ball goes off the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Floated on the stumps, Zaman defends it with calmness.
Shorter on off, Abid punches it wide of cover for one.
Flighted on off, Ali strokes it to cover.
Starts with a floated delivery on off, Abid pushes it to mid off.
Wanindu Hasaranga to have a go with the ball now.
Beaten! Flighted outside off, Fakhar looks to play it with soft hands to the off side but misses it due to the late turn on it.
Follows it up with a single towards point.

FOUR! Abid Ali gets to his fifty in style. Short ball around off, Abid Ali waits and cuts it past point to get to his maiden ODI fifty. He has a hundred to his name and would like to add another one here.
Flighted on off, Abid keeps it out.
Shorter on off, Fakhar strokes it to mid off.
Slower through the air on middle, Fakhar looks to defend but the ball goes to the on side off the upper half of his bat for a single.
POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Full and outside off, driven straight to short extra cover. 10 from this over.
Another short ball, around off, Ali ducks and the ball sails over. Umpire Wilson signals the second bouncer for the over.
WIDE. A bouncer, around off, Ali ducks.
FOUR! GORGEOUS! This time, he finds the gap! Overpitched outside off, Abid comes forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it between cover and point for a boundary!
Full and outside off, Ali plays a crisp-looking cover drive but finds an obstruction.

FOUR! Well played. Kumara goes short, around off and Abid, getting across, picks it away, working it past short fine leg for a boundary. Moves to 42 from 30 balls, with his 7th boundary. 236 more needed from 244 balls.
On a length around off, steered towards third man for a single.

The googly, pitching outside off and spinning back in sharply, Fakhar looks to punch it through the off side but is cramped for room. He perhaps expected the chinaman, but was foxed by the googly. Got an inside edge back towards mid on. A quick single called for, Abid is late in responding but eventually makes it.
SIX! Fine shot! Full and around off, Zaman comes down the track and swings it into oblivion over wide long on!
Full and around off, watchfully blocked out.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, quicker and flatter, Zaman looks to cut but misses.

50-RUN STAND IS UP, without taking too much time. In just 49 balls. Tossed up around leg stump, Abid gets across to flick but ekes out a thick inside edge onto his pads. The ball deflects towards square leg and a single is taken.
Time for spin. Lakshan Sandakan to bowl his left-arm chinaman.

That is a good stop. Fractionally short in length, Zaman pulls it through mid-wicket. Lakshan Sandakan gives it a good chase to his right in the deep and dives full length. Manages to stop the ball cleanly and keep the batsmen to a couple. 10 from the over, 24 from the last 2! 249 more needed from 252 balls.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Again, on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket. This time there is protection. Just a run.
FOUR! Another delicate touch. A length ball, around middle, Abid gets across and tucks it through square leg. The ball, as usual, runs like Usain Bolt.
Outside off, dabbed towards third man for a single.
First bowling change. Lahiru Kumara into the attack. Our colleagues are at loggerheads over predictions. Nabs is irritated on seeing him while Mandy feels a wicket is around the corner.
Outside off, punched straight to short extra cover. 14 from the over!

FOUR! Third one of the over! Poor line and length, full and on middle and leg. Abid gets across and tickles it past a diving short fine leg to fine the fence! Moves to 31 from 24 with his 5th boundary.
Square leg comes in towards mid-wicket now.
FOUR! Boy o boy, is this Azhar Ali or Abid Ali? Very strong wrists, making batting look so easy. Full and straight, Abid gets across and whips it through mid-wicket.
A full toss, on the pads, whipped to deep mid-wicket for just a run.
Down the leg side, Ali gets across and tucks it straight to Dasun Shanaka at short fine leg. A misfield allows a single.
FOUR! FLAMBOYANT! This guy is in good touch. Full and around off, Abid walks across and drives this with the full face of his bat, through mid on. 269 more needed from 263 balls.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Flicks this one away for a run.
Taps this towards point for a quick single.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
FOUR! FANTASTIC! Zaman can play the straight drives too! Overpitched, around middle, Fakahr drives this straight back past the bowler and gets the ball to race to the long off fence.
Full and wide outside off, plenty of outswing, Abid goes after it, aiming to drive and gets a thick outside edge towards third man. A single taken. 279 more needed from 269 balls.
A length ball, around middle, Zaman looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. Inside edge involved.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Lovely shot. Boy, this bloke can bat. Outside off, on a length, Abid punches this on the up through the covers. Avishka Fernando runs after it and looks to slide but then slips while trying to do so. However, he just about manages to push the ball back into play before he touches the ropes. Three runs taken.
Landed outside off, watchfully blocked out.
Around off, defended solidly.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Down the leg side, flicked away for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Miscue but safe. A short ball, outside off, Abid looks to pull but the extra bounce does him in. Gets a top edge which just clears mid-wicket. Two runs taken.
Full and around middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

Ohoho! Swing! Lovely ball. Full and around leg, Zaman looks to flick. But the ball swings in late and hits him on the pads. There is a mild appeal for LBW but it is turned down. Ball Tracker shows the pitching to be outside leg.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short mid-wicket in position now.

FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! Pradeep does the expected mistake of going a bit too straight after conceding a straight drive. Easy-peasy for Abid. He is waiting for it, anticipating the line and flicks it through mid-wicket. 287 more needed from 284 balls.

FOUR! FABULOUS! Not an easy shot, but he has played it to perfection. Full and around off, Abid gets across and drives it with the full face of the bat. The ball, once it makes contact with the turf races away past mid on.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full and around off, pushed down the ground through mid off for a single. Gets off the mark.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler. Shanaka mimes a throw at the striker's end but does not release the ball.
Very straight, is Shanaka but very solid is Abid. Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Pakistan are underway. A length ball, around middle, Abid swings it through square leg for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

Who will bowl with the second new ball? Spinner? Pacer? It appears to be Dasun Shanaka. There is a problem straightaway. There seems to be an issue with the tape on his fingers on both hands. Batsmen can object. Not sure who pointed out but the umpires have made it a point to get those removed. All in readiness.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. A maiden to start.
Full and wide outside off, Fakhar throws his bat at it but misses.
Around off, solidly defended.
Full and around off, pushed straight to cover.
Around middle and off, solidly defended.
Full and outside off, angling away, left alone.

Right then! Welcome back. If you are a geek and a disciplinarian, always punctual and wondering why didn't the game start at the scheduled time of 7.15 pm local (1415 GMT), then, well, Pakistan were way too slow in finishing their quota of overs. So given that there needs to be a minimum of 30 minutes for the break, the delay. Fakhar Zaman and Abid Ali are the openers. Nuwan Pradeep will start off proceedings to Fakhar. Here we go.
